changeSet.author: exensioreload
changeSet.comment:
Add ENRICHMENT_TIMEOUT and EXENSIO_TIMEOUT states to pipeline.
These new states provide honest accounting of records where enrichment or Exensio verification status remains uncertain after timeout periods.
ENRICHMENT_TIMEOUT: Record timed out in ENRICHMENT state with ES NotFound, pp_log NotFound, and Exensio direct lookup NotFound. Indicates uncertain enrichment status requiring manual verification or retry.
EXENSIO_TIMEOUT: Record timed out in EXENSIO_LOADING state with Exensio NotFound. Indicates wafer may not exist in Exensio yet or may not exist at all, requiring manual verification or retry.
Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4 - 3.1: ENRICHMENT_TIMEOUT must be valid status value - 3.2: EXENSIO_TIMEOUT must be valid status value - 3.3: Database constraint must include both new states - 3.4: Status updates to new states must succeed without constraint violations
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE SENDER_STAGE ADD CONSTRAINT chk_sender_stage_status CHECK (status IN ('pending','ENQUEUED','ENRICHMENT','ENRICHMENT_TIMEOUT','EXENSIO_LOADING','EXENSIO_TIMEOUT','DONE','FAILED','CANCELLED'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE SENDER_STAGE ADD CONSTRAINT chk_sender_stage_status CHECK (status IN ('pending','ENQUEUED','ENRICHMENT','EXENSIO_LOADING','DONE','FAILED','CANCELLED'))
